text: Purpose: Orchestrates full yearly update workflow single function call. Signature: Workflow: 1. Detection: Auto-detect missing years via get_years_to_download() 2. Phase (Download): Downloads new years → inst/extdata/ 3. Phase B (Clean): Cleans newly downloaded years → data/cleaned/period_X/ 4. Phase C (Combine): Recombines periods, recalculates evolution columns → data/processed/rwb_combined.rds 5. Phase D (Standardize): Re-standardizes data, applies consolidation rules → data/processed/rwb_standardized.rds 6. Export: Exports package format → data/rwb_standardized.rda 7. Validation: Checks row counts, duplicates, required columns, consolidation count 8. Git Commit: Auto-commits changes descriptive message Returns: Invisible list class rwb_update containing: - status: “success” | “partial” | “failed” - years_downloaded: Years downloaded - years_cleaned: Years cleaned - rows_before/rows_after: Row counts - consolidations_applied: Count consolidation rules applied - validation_passed: TRUE checks pass - messages: Progress messages - git_commit: Commit hash (auto-committed) Error Handling (plan decisions): - Download fails → Aborts error - Cleaning fails → Aborts, reports year failed - Combine/Standardize fails → Aborts - Validation fails → Reports issues; doesn’t abort - Git commit fails → Reports warning; doesn’t abort Example Usage:
code: update_rwb_data(   years = NULL,           # Auto-detect missing years   download = TRUE,        # Phase A: download   clean = TRUE,          # Phase B: clean   combine = TRUE,        # Phase C: combine (always required)   standardize = TRUE,    # Phase D: standardize (always required)   validate = TRUE,       # Run validation checks   verbose = TRUE,        # Print progress   auto_commit = TRUE     # Auto-commit to git ) # Minimal yearly update result <- update_rwb_data() print(result)  # Test without download result <- update_rwb_data(download = FALSE, clean = FALSE)  # Manual years (not auto-detected) result <- update_rwb_data(years = c(2027))

title: Getting Started
text: Reporters Without Borders (RSF) Press Freedom Index measures press freedom across countries annually. {pressfreedom.data} automates downloading, cleaning, standardizing data analysis R. RSF index spans 24 years (2002-2026, 2011 missing RSF publish year) across three methodologically distinct periods: 2002-2012: 16 columns, non-comparable scores 2013-2021: 16 columns, comparable 0-100 scale 2022-2026: 22-25 columns new dimensions (Political, Economic, Legal, Social, Safety) top structural changes, countries renamed reclassified time – 14 pairs consolidated single, current name, including: Turkey -> Turkiye (official name change, 2022) Ivory Coast -> Cote d’Ivoire (RSF standardization) Czech Republic -> Czechia (official name change) Territorial variants also resolved: Cyprus Northern Cyprus kept separate rows (distinct political entities), territorial fragments (e.g., U.S. bases Iraq) removed. audit trail decisions – rows consolidated original name – preserved data/processed/rwb_standardized.rds inside package source, though part exported rwb_standardized dataset described . Every row exported dataset valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, can join datasets without extra cleanup. also found fixed subtle scaling bug RSF’s raw score exports silently inflated many 2013-2026 scores 100x (see FAQ details). package handles automatically, providing single, clean dataset ready analysis. haven’t installed package yet, see README’s Installation section.

code: compare_countries <- c(   "United States", "China", "Brazil", "Nigeria", "Japan", "Germany" )  compare_score <- rwb_standardized |>   filter(country_en %in% compare_countries, year_n >= 2013, !is.na(score)) |>   arrange(country_en, year_n)  compare_rank <- rwb_standardized |>   filter(country_en %in% compare_countries, !is.na(rank)) |>   arrange(country_en, year_n) # Order the legend to match each country's end-of-series score, top to # bottom, instead of the alphabetical default compare_score <- compare_score |>   mutate(country_en = forcats::fct_reorder2(country_en, year_n, score))  ggplot(compare_score, aes(x = year_n, y = score, color = country_en)) +   geom_line() +   geom_point() +   labs(     x = "Year",     y = "Score (100 = most free)",     color = "Country",     title = "Press Freedom Score, 2013-2026"   ) # `.desc = FALSE` because the y-axis is reversed below (rank 1 = best, drawn # at the top); ordering the legend ascending by rank keeps it in the same # top-to-bottom order as the lines at their right-hand endpoints compare_rank <- compare_rank |>   mutate(country_en = forcats::fct_reorder2(     country_en, year_n, rank,     .desc = FALSE   ))  ggplot(compare_rank, aes(x = year_n, y = rank, color = country_en)) +   geom_line(linewidth = 1) +   geom_point(size = 2) +   scale_y_reverse() +   labs(     x = "Year",     y = "Rank (1 = most free)",     color = "Country",     title = "Press Freedom Rank, 2002-2026"   )

title: Visualizing Press Freedom Trends
text: 2022 onward, RSF also reports five sub-dimensions (Political, Economic, Legal, Social, Safety) alongside overall score. Reshaping tidyr::pivot_longer() makes easy plot together one country.
code: us_dims <- rwb_standardized |>   filter(country_en == "United States", year_n >= 2022) |>   select(     year_n, score, political_context, economic_context,     legal_context, social_context, safety   ) |>   tidyr::pivot_longer(     cols = -"year_n",     names_to = "dimension",     values_to = "value"   ) # Order the legend to match each dimension's end-of-series value us_dims <- us_dims |>   mutate(dimension = forcats::fct_reorder2(dimension, year_n, value))  ggplot(us_dims, aes(x = year_n, y = value, color = dimension)) +   geom_line() +   geom_point() +   labs(     x = "Year",     y = "Score (higher is better)",     color = "Dimension",     title = "United States: Overall Score and Sub-Dimensions, 2022-2026"   )

title: Visualizing Press Freedom Trends
text: Averaging score zone year_n (restricted 2013+, since score comparable ) shows regions diverged. black line adds global mean across countries reference.
code: zone_means <- rwb_standardized |>   filter(year_n >= 2013, !is.na(zone), !is.na(score)) |>   group_by(zone, year_n) |>   summarise(mean_score = mean(score), .groups = "drop")  global_mean <- rwb_standardized |>   filter(year_n >= 2013, !is.na(score)) |>   group_by(year_n) |>   summarise(mean_score = mean(score), .groups = "drop") zone_colors <- c(   setNames(scales::hue_pal()(dplyr::n_distinct(zone_means$zone)), sort(unique(zone_means$zone))),   "Global mean" = "black" )  # Order the legend (via `breaks`) to match each line's end-of-series value, # combining the zones and the global mean into one ranking legend_order <- bind_rows(   zone_means |>     filter(year_n == max(year_n)) |>     select("zone", "mean_score"),   global_mean |>     filter(year_n == max(year_n)) |>     transmute(zone = "Global mean", mean_score) ) |>   arrange(desc(mean_score)) |>   pull(zone)  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = year_n, y = mean_score, color = zone)) +   geom_line(data = zone_means) +   geom_point(data = zone_means) +   geom_line(     data = global_mean,     aes(color = "Global mean"),     linewidth = 1   ) +   geom_point(data = global_mean, aes(color = "Global mean")) +   scale_color_manual(values = zone_colors, breaks = legend_order) +   labs(     x = "Year",     y = "Mean score",     color = "Zone",     title = "Mean Press Freedom Score by Region, 2013-2026"   )

title: Visualizing Press Freedom Trends
text: choropleth map gives --glance view press freedom stands globally single year. World country boundaries come {rnaturalearth}; joining rwb_standardized requires common key, iso (package’s ISO 3-letter code) iso_a3 map data. handful small territories map data (dependencies, disputed territories) matching row rwb_standardized, since RSF rates sovereign states; shown grey.
code: world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "small", returnclass = "sf") |>   # Drop Antarctica, keeps the map focused on populated landmass   dplyr::filter(.data$continent != "Antarctica")  scores_2025 <- rwb_standardized |>   filter(year_n == 2025, !is.na(score)) |>   select("iso", "score")  world_scores <- world |>   left_join(scores_2025, by = c("iso_a3" = "iso")) ggplot(world_scores) +   geom_sf(aes(fill = score), color = NA) +   scale_fill_viridis_c(     option = "rocket",     na.value = "grey70",     name = "Score (100 = most free)",     guide = guide_colorbar(       title.position = "top",       title.hjust = 0.5,       barwidth = unit(120, "pt"),       barheight = unit(6, "pt")     )   ) +   coord_sf(     crs = "+proj=robin",     # Crop near the poles (Antarctica already dropped) to remove     # the empty white space a full-globe Robinson projection leaves     # above and below the populated landmass     default_crs = sf::st_crs(4326),     xlim = c(-180, 180),     ylim = c(-60, 85),     expand = FALSE   ) +   theme_void() +   theme(     plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),     legend.position = "bottom",     plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)   ) +   labs(title = "Press Freedom Score by Country, 2025")

title: Resolve Missing-Trailing-Zero Score Scaling — resolve_percent_scaling

title: Update Reporters Without Borders Press Freedom Data — update_rwb_data
text: function implements "minimal disruption principle": new years downloaded cleaned. Phases C-D (combine, standardize) always run evolution columns depend year N-1's data. **Workflow Overview:** 1. **Detection (Phase pre-check)**    - years = NULL, detect missing years via get_years_to_download()    - years missing, report return early (unless standardize = TRUE) 2. **Download (Phase )** - download = TRUE    - Downloads CSVs detected missing years inst/extdata/    - Validates CSV saving    - download failure: aborts update error message 3. **Clean (Phase B)** - clean = TRUE years detected    - Cleans newly downloaded years via clean_rwb_single()    - Outputs normalized RDS data/cleaned/period_X/    - cleaning failure: aborts update reports year failed 4. **Combine (Phase C)** - Always runs (required)    - Recombines cleaned periods via combine_cleaned_periods()    - Recalculates evolution columns (rank_n_1, score_n_1, etc.)    - Output: data/processed/rwb_combined.rds    - Cost: ~1-2 seconds 5. **Standardize (Phase D)** - Always runs (required)    - Re-standardizes rows via standardize_rwb_countries()    - Applies consolidation rules inst/extdata/consolidation_mapping.csv    - Output: data/processed/rwb_standardized.rds    - Cost: ~2-3 seconds 6. **Export**    - Regenerates rwb_standardized.rda via data-raw/rwb_standardized.R    - Cost: <1 second 7. **Validation** - validate = TRUE    - Checks row count increase matches expectations    - Verifies duplicate rows    - Ensures required columns present    - validation failure: reports issues abort 8. **Git Commit** - auto_commit = TRUE    - Stages updated RDS files    - Creates commit message describing changed    - commit failure: reports warning abort update **Intelligent Defaults:** - combine = TRUE, standardize = TRUE: overridden (always required) - validate = TRUE: Recommended production workflows - auto_commit = TRUE: Recommended; provides git history updates - verbose = TRUE: Recommended interactive use **Error Handling:** - Download fails -> Aborts error - Cleaning fails -> Aborts reports year failed - Combine/Standardize fail -> Aborts (indicates data corruption) - Validation fails -> Reports issues; abort - Git commit fails -> Reports warning; abort update **Example: Minimal yearly update** “`r # Run per year new RSF data available result <- update_rwb_data() # Auto-detects missing years, downloads, cleans, combines, standardizes print(result) “` **Example: Testing without download** “`r # Test combining/standardizing without network calls result <- update_rwb_data(years = NULL, download = FALSE, clean = FALSE) “`
